How it works

Three things no other platform does.

The Advisor

A 24/7 AI consultant that understands your exact ability profile

Tell it once. It remembers your devices, sensitivities, and limits — then answers every "can I…?" question before you book.

Magic Itineraries

One-click trips, verified against real local accessibility data

Flights, stays, transit and attractions assembled into a day-by-day plan — every step checked against the ground truth.

The Open API

The bridge connecting hotels, transit and city infrastructure

We sync directly with airlines, rail, and venues so "step-free" means step-free — today, not last year.

Clinical travel assessment

Two minutes now saves a hundred phone calls later.

Answer a few questions and we build your Travel-Needs Profile — the same OT-informed framework Marisol uses with her clients.

🛡️Clinically-informed, never a guess
⚡Powers your Magic Itineraries instantly
❤️Private — you control what's shared

Why we exist

"For millions of people, the hardest part of travel isn't the journey. It's not knowing whether the world will be ready for them when they arrive."

❤️ Because accessibility isn't a feature. It's belonging.

Disparate standards. Inaccurate reviews. A dozen phone calls for one honest answer about a single doorway. Universal Traveler exists to end the guessing game — to replace travel anxiety with freedom and dignity.

Meet the founder

Marisol Lozada, COTA/L

Licensed Occupational Therapy Assistant · 16 Years Experience

I have spent 16 years watching patients and families give up on travel — not because they couldn't, but because the tools to support them didn't exist. Working across Geriatrics, Skilled Nursing, Outpatient Neurology, Outpatient Pediatrics, and Early Education, I saw the same pattern everywhere: people with the desire and the right to explore the world, stopped cold by a lack of reliable, clinically grounded information. Universal Traveler is the platform I wish every one of my clients had.

🩺 COTA/L Licensed 🧠 Neuro Rehab 👴 Geriatrics 🧒 Pediatrics 📚 Early Education

Real-Time Medical Status Tracking
